name: StarGlow Parent
description: Glowing star particles with real 3D parallax. Stars sit at different depths and stay fixed in the scene, so moving or turning the camera or a null parent shifts them in X, Y, Z and orientation. Sizes are in pixels, so Scale 1 looks the same on any layer size. Camera data needs Patcher > Effect Camera Link ON; the Camera Offset XYZ and Orientation params work without it.
